title: 才
teacherNotes: Approved handoff for Production C. Latest origin/main production curriculum is complete through L257; L258-L260 are provisional dependencies, so this package is blocked from merge until those dependencies enter main. Teach 才 mainly as conditional/causal usage; keep S04 as accepted time usage. Use 睡著, not 睡着. Treat 病倒 and 假死 gently; no death, injury, emergency, horror, or medical panic imagery.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Use latest origin/main learned characters through L257 plus provisional learned chars [倒, 病, 假] plus current new char 才.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, readable marks, horror imagery, injury, death imagery, emergency rescue, or medical panic.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 才 as public/assets/lessons/L261/audio/char-u624d.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩過度玩耍或活動後非常累，坐在家裡休息，看起來快要病倒但仍安全。畫面要表現太累所以可能生病的因果，不可呈現重病、急救、死亡、受傷或恐怖；主角小女孩身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。
主角媽媽在晚上提醒主角小女孩早點睡，主角小女孩在床邊準備睡覺。主角小女孩與主角媽媽身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；畫面溫和，不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 只有生病，才可以放病假。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 只有生病才可以放病假
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家裡生病休息，主角媽媽在旁邊照顧，畫面要表現只有真的生病才可以在家放病假。不可出現學校或醫院文字標示；不可呈現重病、急救、死亡、受傷或恐怖；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 才回到家，就倒在床上睡著了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 才回到家就倒在床上睡著了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩剛回到家，就倒在床上睡著，畫面要看出她剛進家門或剛放下東西後非常累。不要畫成跌倒受傷；主角小女孩身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 小狗不想玩了，才會倒下假死。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小狗不想玩了才會倒下假死
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 家裡或戶外安全空地，小狗不想繼續玩，故意倒下假死，主角小女孩在旁邊看著牠。畫面必須明確是小狗玩遊戲裝死，不可呈現真的死亡、受傷、急救、悲傷或恐怖；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

stage4Plan.reason: 「早點睡，才不會累」是本課核心條件用法，語意清楚。

stage4Plan.correctText: 小狗不想玩了，才會倒下假死。

wrongOptions.text: 小狗很想玩了，才會倒下假死。
小狗不想玩了，就會倒下睡著。
